answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 22033 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: yesterday i kept the kaza roza of ramdhan month.but could not complete at around 9.30 in the morning i breaked it..what should i do for kafaara and what is the punishment for it.????? Question: yesterday i kept the kaza roza of ramdhan month.but could not complete at around 9.30 in the morning i breaked it..what should i do for kafaara and what is the punishment for it.????? Answer ID: 22033 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 775/533/L=1431) Breaking missed fast does not make kaffarah (expiation) wajib. It only becomes wajib by breaking the fast in Ramadhan . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
